run_setup_cfg_gpu: run setup_cfg_gpu to configure CUDA, GPU, and distributed training parameters from environment variables
run_all_gather_list: run all_gather_list to gather picklable Python data from all distributed workers into a single list
run_all_reduce: run all_reduce to perform an in-place distributed reduction on a tensor across all workers
run_infer_slurm_init: run infer_slurm_init to infer SLURM-based distributed training init parameters from environment variables
run_get_rank: run get_rank to retrieve the current process rank in a distributed training group
